status: Implemented; build, default and Worker validation passed
change: AggregateState now requires serializedBytes and optionally reports bufferedRows. Growing states measure constant header syntax plus their incremental value bytes without allocating header/result objects. AggregateGroup writes measurements into the admitted per-group accounting record rather than returning a new record. AggregateValuesMemory captures one initial-value supplier; restored contents are traversed only when the cache initializes, avoiding a new mode iterator on every measurement. The snapshot fallback is removed.

coverage: Exact serialized byte and buffered-row limits for growing states across prefixes, Unicode, duplicates and restore
Fixed-state byte limits including nonfinite values
Aggregate checkpoint lifecycle and low-allocation failures
Typecheck requires each aggregate class to provide direct byte measurement

remaining: Mode changed-count entry temporaries are removed via cached entry sizes/count deltas (linked evidence).
Native scalar formatting, expression/evaluator temporaries and request compatibility serialization need broader allocation review.
No wall-clock improvement is claimed without an isolated before/after benchmark.
